title: Hammett's kindness as editor
summary: Freeman never saw Hammett do an unkind act; he politely edited staff writers on the Adakian.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: But to get back to Hammett, I never witnessed an unkind act on his part. A very kind man and he was so nice to

the people who worked on the paper for him and if a man wrote something he didn't approve of, he was so polite and said, 'Well, don't you think it ought to be this way,' and it was a most interesting paper. It talked about books and it talked about --
Did you write anything for it?
